etymology.historical_story: Louisa belongs to a European family of personal names associated with Louis. GfdS traces Louis through French to the Old High German name Ludwig, whose elements refer to fame and battle. That history explains the name's background, but it does not make Louisa a Malay word meaning warrior; in Malay discourse it normally identifies a person. [Source: GfdS](https://gfds.de/vorname-der-woche-luisa-louisa/)
